en.hubeali: H 14964 – Aban, from a man, who said: Abu Abdullahasws has said that:
‘Maryam<sup>as</sup> carried (in her<sup>as</sup>) Isa<sup>as</sup> for nine hours, each hour for a month’.
en.sarwar: 517. Aban, from Umar Bin Yazeed who said: I said to Abu Abdullah (a.s.) that: ‘Al-Mugheira (and his people) are alleging that this day is for the night that approaches it’. So he (a.s.) said: ‘They lie! This day today is for the night that has passed.
The people of Al-Nakhla, when they see the crescent say, ‘The Sacred Month has entered’.
